summary_md: **APL ([@Deloprok](https://x.com/Deloprok/status/2116497365657932232))** announces preview weights from *Loop the Loopies!* by Gao et al. of IQuest Research ([arXiv 2607.16051](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.16051)): **Loopie-20B-A2B** and **Loopie-6B-A0.6B**, looped Transformers with MoE that the paper says beat compute-matched vanilla baselines ([20B](https://huggingface.co/zitian-gao/Loopie-20B-A2B-preview), [6B](https://huggingface.co/zitian-gao/Loopie-6B-A0.6B-preview)).
relevance: Efficient looped MoE models for local reasoning.
